title: bash gate does not read ln, rsync, tar, unzip, patch, curl -o, mkdir or rmdir
detail: Left out of v0.238.0, which read the verbs fb-f113f05860db named. Corpus target counts across all 60,566 Bash calls: mkdir 525, tar 26, ln 22, rmdir 22, rsync 16, unzip 6. rsync and tar write outside a sprint's writable set the same way cp does. Each is one branch in _file_verb_targets; replay first as v0.238.0 did, and curl -o needs its flags read since 1,631 curl calls mostly write nothing.
